description: This file contains helper functions and includes for unit testing C++ components, specifically related to time-stamp verification, JSON data packing, and external dependencies handling within a test framework.

methods.name: void verify_timestamp(const jsoncons::json & result)
methods.description: Verifies that a JSON object contains a timestamp key, that it is a string, and matches an ISO 8601 format.

methods.name: void verify_timestampZero(const jsoncons::json & result)
methods.description: Verifies that a JSON object contains a timestamp key, that it is a string, and matches an ISO 8601 format, comparing with a zero timestamp value.

methods.name: void verify_and_erase_timestamp(jsoncons::json & result)
methods.description: Verifies timestamp as above and then erases the timestamp key for simplified comparison.

methods.name: void verify_and_erase_timestampZero(jsoncons::json & result)
methods.description: Verifies zero timestamp as above and then erases the timestamp key.

methods.name: jsoncons::json packDataInJson(const VSSPath & path,const std::string & value)
methods.description: Packages a VSSPath and value into a JSON object with a timestamp, for testing data submission.
